title: Local Staging activation schema and runtime read-authority reconciliation

phases.objective: Fail closed when the eight Activation hard-run registry tables are absent, reconcile action-governance/OAuth metadata through an additive migration, and restore only the bounded SELECT authority required by local Staging activation/session-context and registry reads while leaving Production bootstrap grants unchanged. The same overlay permits SELECT-only identity resolution across users, memberships and tenants for authenticated Staging readiness.

e2e_journeys.actor: Local Windows Docker Staging recovery operator
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Local Staging schema census blocks incomplete Activation registry state, canonical schema replay supplies the runtime action metadata columns, repository-owned grant reconciliation supplies only the proven SELECT surfaces, and same-cycle certification can proceed without Production/provider mutation or broad runtime database authority.
steps: Bind local Staging repair and schema replay to the exact eligible main commit.
Build the schema-only three-role bundle from canonical schema plus ordered repository migrations.
Require all eight Activation hard-run registry tables in the runtime schema census before restart/certification.
Apply the additive action runtime contract migration through the governed local Staging schema lifecycle when schema reconciliation is authorized.
Reconcile the repository-owned Staging runtime grant plan so activation/session-context, registry, graph-memory and hard-run source tables receive SELECT only.
Preserve existing bounded write authority only on the pre-existing runtime bootstrap tables.
Run schema/grant readback and same-cycle Staging certification.
Grant the Staging runtime principal SELECT-only access to users, memberships and tenants so authenticated principal discovery and OAuth issuance can resolve active identities.
assertions: The eight Activation hard-run registry tables are required by the local Staging runtime schema census.
The actions reconciliation migration is additive and idempotent and adds allowed_actor_roles, allowed_governance_levels, oauth_secret_storage_type and oauth_last_validated_at only when absent.
Every newly introduced Staging runtime surface is constrained to SELECT in required_operations_by_table.
No schema-wide grant, GRANT ALL, CREATE, ALTER, DROP, GRANT OPTION, Production DB access, provider call, Hostinger mutation, Cloudflare mutation, or secret value is introduced.
users, memberships and tenants are present only in the Staging runtime overlay and each is constrained to SELECT; Production bootstrap grants and identity-table write authority remain unchanged.

phases.objective: Production activation, database mutation and provider mutation remain outside this patch.
blockers: Production requires a separate governed promotion and authorization lifecycle.
This declaration grants no Production database, provider, Hostinger, Cloudflare or deployment mutation authority.
